annotations.title: Screen a name against US, UK and EU sanctions lists

description: Sanctions screening (AML/KYC): screen a person, company, vessel or aircraft against the OFAC SDN and consolidated lists, the UK Sanctions List and the EU financial sanctions list, read from the governments' own files with each list's date returned. Fuzzy and word-order free: aliases and typos match, a different surname does not. Each hit: list, programmes, countries, birth dates, UN reference. Input: name; optional type, country, birth_year. $0.05 per call. Returns: query{}, verdict (potential_match | no_match), match_count, matches[{list, list_name, id, name, matched_name, score, type, programs[], countries[], birth_dates[], un_reference, listed_on, source_url}], lists[{list, name, publisher, license, source_url, as_of, entries, loaded}], notes[], checked_at.

birth_year.description: Optional, for people: a listing whose recorded birth years are all more than a year away is dropped.

country.description: Optional country (Iran, Russia): a listing that records only other countries is dropped.

language.description: Optional BCP-47 language tag (en, ja, ko, pt-BR): the human-readable strings of the result (notes, details, reasons) are translated into this language; data, codes, numbers and URLs are untouched. Default: as produced.

lists.description: Optional subset of lists to screen. Default all four.

name.description: The person, company, vessel or aircraft name, in any word order.

type.description: Only match this kind of listing. Default any.
